title: Enterprise Procurement Platform
description: A comprehensive enterprise procurement ecosystem spanning Source-to-Contract (S2C) and Procure-to-Pay (P2P) cycles for high-volume organizational purchasing. After completing a full stack client implementation project, I transitioned into product R&D to advance the platform's analytical capabilities and manage AI integrations. My focus centers on developing spend analysis features, demand planning intelligence, executive monitoring dashboards, and integrating AI services to optimize strategic sourcing decisions.

title: Centralized Vendor Database
description: A centralized vendor qualification database connecting production sharing contractors across the upstream oil and gas sector to unify legal, financial, and technical vendor compliance. Alongside engineering backend verification logic and data models during implementation, I managed application deployments and release cycles, while partnering closely with system analysts to define technical scopes and sprint deliverables.

title: Hygiene Inspection System
description: An end-to-end quality assurance system for commercial catering, tracking food hygiene standards across every milestone, from ingredient receiving and temperature-regulated storage to packaging and delivery. Along with developing the backend, I translated business requirements into technical tasks for frontend developers and coordinated delivery schedules.

title: Catering Management System
description: A full-lifecycle catering management platform covering supplier procurement, inventory control, and multi-tier customer orders (daily menus, individual packages, and custom requests). It incorporates a cost-optimization algorithm for menu item bundling and automates daily dispatch and invoicing. I also coordinated frontend execution alongside backend engineering.

title: Attendance System
description: A workforce attendance system accommodating complex working scenarios, including automated overtime calculation, leave approvals, and actual labor hour computations. The verified attendance records integrate as core input for an external payroll system. I developed the backend services and assisted in coordinating change requests with the frontend team.

title: Rehabilitation Management System
description: Known as SIKELABANG, this administrative platform manages correctional client rehabilitation programs, transitioning traditional manual paper routines into a unified digital workflow. Features hierarchical approval tiers, automated document generation, verifiable digital signatures, and transparent progress tracking accessible to both probation officers and correctional clients.

title: Tour Management System
description: A travel booking platform connecting motorcycle touring enthusiasts with cross-Indonesia excursion packages. The platform provides detailed trip itineraries, seamless online registration, and automated payment gateway processing for instant booking confirmations.

title: Digital Bartering Platform
description: A peer-to-peer bartering marketplace that brings traditional trade exchange into a modern e-commerce experience. Users list items with condition ratings, explore other listings, and initiate direct trade proposals to exchange goods without monetary transactions.

title: Corporate Training Website
description: The official digital platform for Accredited International Academy (AIA Training), delivering certified ISO Lead Auditor programs and corporate management training across Indonesia. The website features comprehensive course directories, syllabus breakdowns, registration inquiry workflows, and an online certification verification system.

title: Corporate Certification Website
description: Official company website for PT. Valuabilitas Reabilitas Certi (VRC International), an accredited ISO management system certification body. Includes structured ISO standards guides, responsive UI with dark/light themes, inquiry workflows, and real-time certificate validity verification.
